details: Bitcoin climbed to $62,000 on July 3rd, a 7.3% recovery from its low, after the US added only 57,000 jobs in June, lowering Federal Reserve rate hike expectations. US spot Bitcoin ETFs also recorded $221.7 million in net inflows on Thursday, breaking a 10-day outflow streak, contributing to the rebound. The move follows Fed Chair comments signaling reduced inflation risks.
title: Bitcoin Rises Above $62K After Weak US Jobs Report and ETF Inflows

details: Bitcoin gained 2.56% on Thursday, showing a bullish divergence and reaching the daily TBO Fast line. However, a full trend shift is unconfirmed as prior attempts at the Fast line were rejected, and BTC remains bearish beneath the daily TBO Cloud. Improved OBV support offers an early reversal indicator, but market caution persists.
title: Bitcoin Posts 2.56% Gain, But Trend Reversal Not Confirmed
